from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing metrics extracted from a release document."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The calendar month the data represents, e.g., '2022-08'")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing completions")
    units_under_construction: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Total Units Under Construction")
    source_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued (e.g., '2022-09-20'), used to determine precedence")
    data_status: str | None = Field(description="Indication if data is preliminary, revised, or final as noted in the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
